Container.Name: watch_sync
Container.Overview: Mirrors Plex watch status from source accounts to target accounts (e.g. a shared "Family" account to individual profiles). Polls Plex's own watch-history endpoint in the background; manage sync rules from its web UI.

Config.Name: Appdata (read-only)
Config.Description: Your whole appdata share, read-only - used to auto-find Plex's Preferences.xml without needing its exact container/folder name

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Rules database, sync watermarks, activity log

Config.Name: POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS
Config.Description: How often (seconds) to poll Plex for new watch history

Config.Name: FIRST_RUN_HOURS
Config.Description: How far back a rule looks on its very first run, before it has a watermark
